name: Maxio Advanced Billing (Chargify)
tagline: Subscription billing and revenue management API for SaaS and recurring commerce
description: Maxio Advanced Billing (formerly Chargify) is a subscription billing and revenue management API for SaaS and recurring commerce. It covers customers, subscriptions, products, invoices, payments, dunning, usage metering, and reporting against a site-specific Advanced Billing subdomain.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and empty (or 'x') password; keys created in Maxio Advanced Billing site settings. OAuth/token flows also documented for some integrations.

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial SaaS pricing via Maxio sales/self-serve; Advanced Billing is product-priced, not per-request API metering (confirm on maxio.com).

use_cases: list active subscriptions for a billing site
create a customer and start a recurring subscription
record metered usage against a subscription component
fetch invoices and payment status for a customer
update product prices or coupon codes via API
cancel or reactivate a subscription with proration options
